modification: Modified SOLVE_MATH_PROMPT to add an explicit step 0 "DECOMPOSE" that asks the model to break the problem into a sequence of smaller, independent sub-questions before reading/planning/solving. This is fundamentally different from unit tracking, verification, substitution, CHECK strengthening, or quantity extraction — it structures the problem hierarchically upfront, guiding the solver through a dependency chain of sub-problems rather than a flat list of arithmetic steps.
